local_map.title: Fully local connection
local_map.description: IP address and 32-character token. Everything runs over your LAN. You get the token with the guide's tools (https://github.com/Krystianpoprostu/jonr-local/blob/main/docs/LOCAL_MODE.md); afterwards load the map with **Configure → Download the map from your Xiaomi account**. Easier: go back and choose **Xiaomi account once → fully local**.

account_local.title: Sign in once to your Xiaomi account
account_local.description: Use the account your robot is paired to in Mi Home. The integration finds the robot (IP address and token) and downloads its map **once**. Your password and the Xiaomi session are **not stored**: after setup everything runs over your local network, and you can block the robot from the internet on your router.

saved_device.title: Confirm your robot
saved_device.description: Found **{robot}**. Check its local IP address (set a fixed address for it on your router if you can) and choose a name — entity ids are created from the name. Next, the map is downloaded once; the robot may stay offline for this.

saved_map_outdated.title: Saved map looks outdated
saved_map_outdated.description: The robot cleaned room ids {rooms} that are not in the saved map. The robot's map has probably changed. Bring the robot online briefly, check the map in Mi Home, then run tools/dump_map.py and import the new copy with jonr_local.import_map.

saved_map_missing.title: Your robot's map is not downloaded yet
saved_map_missing.description:
Room cleaning, room names and the map card need the robot's map. Get it once:

1. **Settings → Devices & services → JONR Local → Configure**.
2. Choose **Download / refresh the map from your Xiaomi account** and sign in.

Your password is not stored and the robot may stay offline. If it says there is no map yet, map your home in the Mi Home app first (robot online).
